result.reason: The added Section 9.6 achieves the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and owes no further fees for terminated Services. Vendor is expressly denied a convenience-termination right during a committed term. The amendment is narrowly confined to the required termination right, leaves the existing term and breach provisions intact, and is professionally drafted.
